concerns.text: Task T022 (Flagging Logic) is marked unimplemented `[ ]` and depends on T025c (contaminated mask), which is also unimplemented. FR-003 and FR-009 mandate that the detector MUST exclude contaminated windows to prevent baseline suppression. By leaving T025a/b/c unimplemented, the task list effectively removes the core logic required to satisfy FR-009, weakening the functional requirement to a partial implementation that cannot pass the spec's acceptance criteria.

Tasks T032a and T032b (Independence Checks) are marked unimplemented `[ ]`. FR-006 and FR-008 mandate that the pipeline MUST halt immediately with `SystemExit(1)` if correlation > 0.8. Without these tasks implemented, the downstream ground-truth generation (T031) lacks the mandatory blocking gate, violating Constitution Principle VI (Statistical Independence) and FR-004's validity condition.

Task T013 (Download) and T016 (Aggregation) are marked unimplemented `[ ]`. FR-001 requires the system to ingest logs and produce a merged CSV with computed divergence signals. T016 is the specific deliverable for this aggregation. Leaving T016 unimplemented means the output artifact required for US2 and US3 does not exist, rendering the downstream tasks (T021, T031) impossible to execute and violating the data flow mandated by the spec.

Task T031 (Ground Truth Derivation) is unimplemented `[ ]` and depends on T032a/b. FR-004 explicitly states ground-truth derivation is valid ONLY if FR-006/008 pass. Since the blocking tasks (T032a/b) are unimplemented, T031 cannot legally execute per the spec's logic. The task list presents a broken dependency chain that prevents the fulfillment of FR-004.

Tasks T033-Pre (Config Definition) and T033 (Baseline Generation) are unimplemented `[ ]`. FR-005 requires a Wilcoxon test against a 'stratified random baseline'. T033 is the sole task defining this baseline. Without it, the statistical significance test (T034a) lacks its required control group, violating FR-005 and SC-002.
